milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a magma_block with a pickaxe causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no magma_block in inventory (verified via sandbox inventory screenshot), so finding magma_block >= 1 confirms the block was successfully mined with the provided diamond pickaxe. This is preferred over a voxel/position check because it directly verifies the player obtained the drop, not just that the block disappeared.
